verdict.rationale: Findings carry both a CVSS severity and a confidence score, and Gecko posts a pass/fail check to gate PRs, giving raw material for triage (gecko-security-docs-2, gecko-security-docs-5). However, there's no documented feature for configuring severity/confidence thresholds to selectively suppress or gate on noise, and community reports of high-confidence false positives (gecko-security-comm-3) suggest the confidence score may not reliably separate signal from noise. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API controls to set severity/confidence gating thresholds, documented policy configuration for build-blocking, and evidence that confidence scores reliably correlate with true positives.
